country: # Catalunya: kiting is banned on all Catalan beaches 1 Jun–30 Sep except in authorised kite zones.

name: Empuriabrava – La Rubina
notes: Authorised summer kite zone at the Santa Margarida end (natural park beach); best in easterlies.

name: Sant Pere Pescador
notes: Authorised summer kite zone (beginner and advanced sectors); tramuntana and summer thermal.

name: L'Estartit – Gola del Ter
notes: Summer kite zone (1 Jun–30 Sep) run by the local school; kite pass / registration required.

name: Malgrat de Mar – La Pomareda
notes: Municipal kite zone looked after by Club Kite Malgrat; SW thermal Mar–Sep.

name: Barcelona – Nova Mar Bella
locate: q:Platja de la Nova Mar Bella
notes: No official kite zone: kiting banned 1 Jun–30 Sep; off-season levante / gregal days only.

name: Castelldefels
notes: Authorised summer kite zone (online registration required).

name: Torredembarra
notes: Off-season spot: kiting banned 1 Jun–30 Sep. Keep off the protected Muntanyans dunes east of town.

name: La Pineda
notes: Kiting banned 1 Jun–30 Sep (Catalan coast rule).

name: Riumar (Ebro delta)
notes: Authorised summer kite zone; best in mestral (NW, cross-shore), summer southerlies are offshore.

name: Platja dels Eucaliptus (Ebro delta)
notes: Shallow water at the root of the Trabucador; beginner-friendly.

name: El Trabucador (Ebro delta)
notes: Authorised summer kite zone; flat water on the Badia dels Alfacs (west) side.

country: # Comunitat Valenciana: summer kiting only in the few buoyed channels / zones.

name: Burriana – El Arenal
notes: Winter spot for southerlies; flat water between the harbour moles.

name: Valencia – El Perellonet
notes: Municipal buoyed kite zone south of the Perellonet river mouth, open year-round; Kitezone club.

name: Sueca – Mareny de Barraquetes
notes: Summer channel (Jun–Aug) for Barraquetes Vent club members only; free off-season. Summer garbí thermal.

name: Oliva
notes: Oliva Nova; in summer kiting only in the authorised zone (club rescue boat).

name: Dénia – Les Deveses
notes: Marked kite zone at the north end of Dénia (Les Deveses); summer thermal and winter tramuntana.

name: Elche – Arenales del Sol
notes: Municipal kite area with schools.

name: Santa Pola – La Gola
locate: q:Playa de La Gola Santa Pola
notes: La Gola open to kites year-round; neighbouring Playa Lisa is closed to kites in summer.

name: Guardamar – Els Tossals
notes: Designated kite area by the dunes.

name: Mar Menor – Los Narejos
notes: Flat-water lagoon, kite zone and school; E and SW (lebeche) most common.

name: Mar Menor – Los Nietos
notes: Shallow flat water, onshore in NE/E; beginner-friendly, no summer restriction at the end of the promenade.

name: La Manga – Isla del Ciervo
notes: Mar Menor side at km 3; summer jellyfish nets close the bathing areas (no riding inside).

name: Almería – El Zapillo
notes: City beach, poniente side-shore; no kiting 15 Jun–15 Sep.

name: Roquetas de Mar – Las Salinas
notes: Long beach used in poniente and levante; restricted during the bathing season.

name: Almerimar
notes: Poniente (W) spot by the marina: flat between the breakwaters, waves further out.

name: Motril – Playa Granada
notes: Levante and poniente; shorebreak in strong poniente. School on the beach.

name: Málaga – Los Álamos
notes: Official kite zone (Los Álamos / Guadalmar), moved during the bathing season; SW thermal Apr–Oct.

name: Marbella – Los Monteros
notes: Río Real: summer access only through the buoyed channel (levante); poniente waves in winter. Rocky entry.

country: # Andalucía — Strait and Cádiz Atlantic coast

name: Algeciras – Palmones
notes: Strong-levante alternative to Tarifa (weaker wind); no kiting in summer; keep out of the river and marsh reserve.

name: Tarifa – Balneario
notes: Experts only (rocks, currents); levante freestyle, poniente waves. No kiting 15 Jun–15 Sep.

name: Tarifa – Los Lances
notes: Los Lances Norte (Río Jara–Waves). Summer: school and free-rider zones only, no kiting from Río Jara to town 15 Jun–15 Sep.

name: Tarifa – Valdevaqueros
notes: Includes Punta Paloma; summer kite zone is crowded; rocks at low tide.

name: Bolonia
notes: No kiting in summer.

name: Los Caños de Meca
locate: q:Playa de Los Caños de Meca
notes: Levante spot; rocks towards the lighthouse at low tide; officially no kiting in summer.

name: El Palmar (Vejer)
locate: q:Playa de El Palmar Vejer de la Frontera
notes: Westerlies; ride the south end, watch surfers and bathers; rocks at low tide.

name: Chiclana – Sancti Petri
notes: Winter: free; summer only inside the water-sports channels.

name: San Fernando – Camposoto
notes: Westerlies; summer channel at the end of the promenade; local kite club.

name: Cádiz – Cortadura
notes: Westerlies; rocky bottom, high tide recommended.

name: El Puerto – Valdelagrana
notes: Space in winter and summer (summer water-sports channel).

name: Rota – El Rompidillo
notes: Winter spot for all levels; move elsewhere in the bathing season.

name: Punta Umbría
notes: Long open beach with waves; SW thermal; summer restrictions near bathers.

name: El Portil
notes: Flat water behind the El Rompido sandspit (cross the Río Piedras); strong currents.

name: Isla Cristina – La Casita Azul
notes: Designated kite zone; restricted from 15 Jun in summer.

name: Ayamonte – Isla Canela
notes: Shallow sandbars by the Guadiana mouth, beginner-friendly; SW thermal Apr–Sep.

name: Doniños (Ferrol)
notes: Exposed Atlantic beach: waves, experienced riders.

name: Razo (Carballo)
notes: Open Atlantic (waves); the Baldaio lagoon next door is flat at high tide.

name: A Lanzada
notes: Huge exposed beach; best autumn–winter.

name: O Grove – A Mexilloeira
notes: Sheltered ría beach: flat water in N–NE; school.

name: A Illa de Arousa – O Bao
notes: Flat water in the ría; works in S–SE (winter).

name: Redondela – Cesantes
notes: Flat water at the head of the Vigo ría; SW summer thermal.

name: Vigo – O Vao
notes: Flat water behind the Toralla island in W–NW.

name: Salinas – San Juan de Nieva
notes: Strong wind and waves; advanced riders.

name: Gijón – El Arbeyal
notes: Sheltered by the breakwater, N–NE; all levels. Space depends on the tide.

name: Gijón – San Lorenzo
notes: NE–E; launch space depends on the tide; summer restrictions.

name: Luanco – Santa Marina
notes: Protected by jetties; works in E–SE and N.

name: Somo
notes: Waves on the open beach; flat water in La Poza (Miera estuary) at low–mid tide, schools there.

name: Santander – Los Peligros
notes: Bay beach for SW (gusty, choppy); no kiting 1 Jun–30 Sep.

name: Laredo – Salvé
notes: Flat water; stay upwind of bathers.

name: Embalse de La Loteta
notes: Reservoir ridden in the cierzo (NW), which blows along its length; south launch area with Club Kitesurf La Loteta. Shallow and rocky in places: check the water level.

name: Mallorca – Pollença (Sa Marina)
notes: Authorised kite zone and schools in the Bay of Pollença.

name: Mallorca – Platja de Muro
notes: Small authorised channel; crowded in summer, best off-season.

name: Mallorca – Son Serra de Marina
locate: q:Platja de Son Serra de Marina
notes: Island's main kite beach Oct–May; summer restrictions.

name: Menorca – Cala Tirant
notes: Waves with the tramuntana (N); summer: designated launch area only.

name: Menorca – Son Bou
notes: Waves in westerlies; summer: designated launch area only.

name: Fuerteventura – Costa Calma
notes: Flatter water, fewer riders than Sotavento.

name: Fuerteventura – Sotavento
notes: Lagoon at low tide (flat, knee-deep); open sea at high tide. World Cup venue.

name: Lanzarote – Famara
notes: Waves, trade wind; currents.

name: Lanzarote – Costa Teguise
notes: Las Cucharas; waves, schools; gusty close to shore.

name: Lanzarote – Playa Honda
notes: Best Lanzarote option in easterlies: long beach, flat water.

name: Gran Canaria – Vargas
notes: Strong trade wind Apr–Sep; waves.

name: Gran Canaria – Bahía Feliz
notes: Smaller waves than Pozo / Vargas; school (Club Mistral).

name: Gran Canaria – Pozo Izquierdo
notes: Very strong wind, waves, rocky: experts.

name: Tenerife – El Médano
notes: Trade wind May–Oct; shallow water at the north end.
